Siddaganga Institute of Technology (SIT), Tumakuru, established in 1963, is an autonomous institution affiliated to Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belagavi. It is one of the 122 institutions run by the Sree Siddaganga Education Society, founded by His Holiness Padma Bhushana, Karnataka Ratna Dr. Sree Sree Sivakumara Swamiji, who served society selflessly for 111 years. Today, the institute thrives under the guidance of His Holiness Sree Sree Siddalinga Swamigalu.
Academic Excellence:SIT offers 13 undergraduate and 6 postgraduate programs, with 16 VTU-recognized research programs.
National Rankings & Accolades:SIT consistently ranks among the top 100 engineering colleges in NIRF rankings and is accredited withNAAC A++grade

Together can accomodate 2,100 students in a plinth area of 30,021 Sq.m. each hostel block is managed under the supervision of a Deputy Warden who is a faculty member of S.I.T. He is assisted by managers and workers. Each room in all the hostels has been furnished with cots, tables, chairs, book racks and a ceiling fan. Parents and guardians of the students are being provided accommodation in guest house on nominal rent whenever they visit college and wish to stay during their visits. They are also permitted to use the mess facilities in the hostels.

The Central Library occupies a prominent position at the heart of the SIT campus, housed across two independent three-storeyed buildings with a combined plinth area of 1,851 sq. mt. The building was generously funded by Sri T.N. Kempahonnaiah, a distinguished philanthropist from Tumkur, whose contribution continues to benefit generations of students and researchers.

With a total collection of 1,41,844 volumes, the library serves as a comprehensive knowledge repository encompassing general volumes (62,046), Book Bank holdings (36,459), SC/ST Book Bank resources (14,863), and T-Series volumes (28,476). The reference collection includes authoritative Dictionaries, Encyclopaedias, Handbooks, and Standards.

The library subscribes to 116 technical periodicals — approximately 20 of which are international — and maintains a back-volume archive of nearly 3,993 periodical issues. The library is fully computerised on NewGenLib, an open-source web-enabled platform, enabling campus-wide OPAC access for seamless book discovery by author or title.

1. Bio Energy Research, Information and Demonstration Centre (BRIDC)
District Biofuel Research and Information Centre, Mechanical Engineering Department was inaugurated by Dr. Sri Sri Sri Shivakumara Swamiji on 10th August 2011.
District Biofuel Information and Demonstration Centre is a funded project by Karnataka State Bioenergy Development Board (KSBDB) managed by Ministry of Rural Development and Panchayat Raj.

Biofuel I & D Centre is creating awareness by conducting training programme for the development and maintenance of Non-Edible oil seed plants. KSBDB is funding to conduct 25 awareness programmes every year.

Farmers, NGOs and rural school children are educated about the importance of the Non-Edible oil seed plants. Farmers are supported to grow the non-edible seed plants on the bunds and barren land by utilising the programmes like Baradu Bangara and Suvarnabhoomi schemes.

Information and Demonstration Centre, Siddaganga Institute of Technology is producing 50 litres of Biodiesel per day. Produced biodiesel is utilised in college DC generators and vehicles and its performance is studied regularly.

This programme is supporting UG, PG and PhD scholars for doing research work. Students and research scholars have published research papers on development and characterization of biodiesel from different species.

Department of  Civil Engineering

The Department of Civil Engineering has been in existence since the inception of SIT in 1963. It has grown into a full-fledged department with specializations in all the major areas of Civil Engineering. The academic programmes offered by the department are B.E. in Civil Engineering, M.Tech (Structural Engineering), M.Tech (Transportation Engineering & Management), M.Sc. Engg (by research), and Ph.D.

The departmental academic activities include designing curriculum for the contemporary needs of the civil engineering profession, delivering it through appropriately designed teaching methods at UG and PG levels, and assessing the effectiveness of delivery through examinations, quizzes, etc., along with career counseling for students. Other co-curricular academic activities are designed to fill gaps in the curriculum. These include field visits, participation in workshops, conferences, hackathons, design competitions, ideathons, etc. Students of the Civil Engineering department also participate in extracurricular activities such as sports, social service (NSS), yoga, NCC, etc.

In addition to academic activities, the department is involved in research and development work and offers consultancy and technical services to industry and society. With the introduction of PG programs and recognition of the department as a VTU research centre, the focus widened to PG studies and research in addition to UG activities. Faculty members are encouraged to upgrade their qualifications and improve their knowledge base.

With SIT becoming an autonomous institution under VTU in 2007, curricula have been continuously updated to meet industry needs. The department has adopted an outcome-based assessment system since 2014. Around 70% of graduating students are placed in industry, while 30% pursue higher studies or entrepreneurship.

The alumni of the department are employed in academic institutions, industry, and government organizations across different states of the country and abroad, with many occupying prestigious positions. The department is recognized as one of the best Civil Engineering departments in the state of Karnataka.

To become a Premier Civil Engineering Department offering excellent engineering education in design methods and advanced technologies to the students, to pursue research in thrust areas and to offer professional service to the society.

The Department is committed to develop competent professionals by offering need based curriculum in Civil Engineering areas, promoting research and innovation to prepare the students for higher study, life-long learning and societal responsibility. The department is also committed to provide good learning environment to develop professional ethics and skills in our students and to provide engineering services to the society.

The incubation center provides state-of-the-art facilities, mentorship from industry experts, access to funding opportunities, and a collaborative ecosystem where ideas can be transformed into market-ready products.

For SIT students, SIF is more than just an incubator—it is a launchpad that bridges academics and real-world application, enabling them to gain hands-on experience, develop entrepreneurial skills, and create impactful solutions that address societal and industrial challenges.
